The '''Skytrooper Factory''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] factory located in the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] and [[Lana Beniko]] fought many [[skytrooper]]s in the factory during their [[Rescue of the Outlander|escape]] from the Spire.<ref name="SWTOR" />
